example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা রণচণ্ডী, কোনো কাজে বাধা দিলে সহ্য করতে পারে না।
বাড়িতে রণচণ্ডীর মতো আচরণ করলে শান্তি থাকবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: She is a real hellcat; she can't tolerate any interruption in her work.
Acting like a firebrand at home won't bring any peace.
history: References the goddess Chandi, a fierce form of Durga, depicted as a warrior in Hindu mythology and Bengali folklore.
note: The idiom draws from the Devi Mahatmya where Chandi battles demons, symbolizing unyielding ferocity.
